Elephants Without Long Tusks
Ivory poaching is causing a serious problem in Africa. Because many elephants are killed for their long tusks, their genes can’t be passed down. Elephants without long tusks are lucky that they are not killed, but life isn’t easy for them. Tusks are important to elephants because they are useful tools for getting food and water, moving heavy things, and protecting themselves. Elephants with short or no tusks have trouble doing these things. For the future of elephants, people need to stop poaching.

items.p: 課文理解・L4 補充閱讀
items.a:
【L4 補充閱讀】
Murphy’s Law
Picture this: it’s breakfast time. You are going to take a bite of a nice, warm piece of toast. Then you drop it and it falls. You pray for it to land on the side without butter. But no—it lands butter-side down! This is a perfect example of Murphy’s Law.
Have you noticed that it always rains when you least expect it? Or when you stand in line at the checkout, why does the line next to you always seem to move faster? And why does your teacher always call on you when you don’t know the answer? If it is possible for something to go wrong, it will go wrong—this is Murphy’s Law.
The lesson behind Murphy’s Law is to be prepared for the worst. So, if you aren’t ready for tomorrow’s test, don’t even think about cheating. The teacher might look your way right when you’re doing something wrong. The smarter choice is to study hard!

Q: Which is NOT an example of Murphy’s Law?
o: You just finished washing your car, and it starts to rain.
You need to talk to someone right away, but they aren’t answering the phone.
When you forget your wallet, someone pays for you.
The school bus always comes late when you have a test on that day.
